description: For arbitrary terms \(x,y,z\) and any finite additional context \(\Gamma\) over their original names, the specified operation consumes an actual HA certificate of \((x+\overline1)\cdot y=z\) and returns one of \(x\cdot y+y=z\). It applies the stated sum-expansion operation to that input tree, then composes the reverse left-one instance within addition.
